notes.title: Demo v0.1.2 Hotfix
notes.content: [h3]Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Crafter recipes now use the same visual style as the new resource boxes for consistency.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial 1 now includes guidance on using time controls and how to progress through tutorial messages.[/p][/*][*][p]Message texts now advance at 400% speed for improved pacing.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a VSync toggle to the settings panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now choose a target frame rate: 30, 60, 144, or unlimited.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would not exit road placement mode when unpaused via the time speed buttons or tutorial message box. This previously caused drone logic to break.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug where modules could stop functioning if a drone gathering resources was unassigned. Drones already carrying or about to carry resources will now be the last to be unassigned.[/p][/*][/list]
